tone.target: bright melodic hard-rock crunch with smooth sustain
tone.profile: bright melodic hard-rock crunch with smooth sustain
tone.summary: A classic British crunch setup using the UK 45 amp model, boosted by a Green OD for upper-mid bite and controlled gain. The signal is shaped with Guitar EQ 1 for tonal balance and finished with Chorus for melodic flair.
corrections: lean more melodic than generic crunch
